parts.text: What is the immediate field recovery protocol when a cashier encounters an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze, and how do we ensure the customer is not double-charged?

For an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze on Toshiba TCx 810 hardware: Instruct the customer to hold and remove their payment card/device, cancel tender on the POS terminal display, soft reboot the PIN pad or power-cycle the reader, verify gateway settlement in the electronic journal, confirm that an automatic reversal (0420 reversal message) is generated to prevent double-charging, and print a void or unsettled verification slip if requested by the customer. Refer to the certified Toshiba TCx 810 Hardware, Diagnostics & Service Guide.
